setup-title.purpose: The one page title on a setup screen.

card-title.purpose: Heading of a panel such as the dusk panel.

step-title.purpose: Heading of each step in a step path.

brand.purpose: The wordmark beside the lamp dot.

column-head.purpose: Heading of a small side note.

lede.purpose: Paragraph under the title, in ink2, max 64ch.

body.purpose: Step paragraphs and general copy, max 62ch.

button.purpose: Control labels inside setup; base buttons elsewhere are 13px.

mono.purpose: Step numbers and inline file names, tabular numerals.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: The dusk panel and anything floating above the page.

shadows.name: glow
shadows.purpose: A lit lamp: cream gap, amber ring, amber haze. State, not elevation.

shadows.name: focus
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus ring on every focusable element.

motion.name: dur-1
motion.purpose: Control state changes (hover, press, skip link).

motion.name: dur-2
motion.purpose: Small entrances such as the tick popping in; the delay before the next lamp lights.

motion.name: dur-3
motion.purpose: Light: lamps and strings filling; the screen settling in.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one long ease-out used for every transition.

motion.name: enter-y
motion.purpose: Distance a screen rises as it mounts.

motion.name: breathe
motion.purpose: The current lamp. Replaced by a steady glow under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: setup-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Two-column setup body becomes one column (token --bp-setup).

breakpoints.name: setup-phone
breakpoints.purpose: Rail spreads and keeps only the current label; foot stops sticking; gutter drops to 12px. Applied as a literal; no token.

narrative.overview:
The system is a porch in the early evening. Pages are warm paper, the writing is navy ink, and the only bright thing is lamplight: amber dots that glow where something is lit. A lamp is lit for a step that is done, the lamp of the step you are on breathes, and a string between lamps fills as you go. Everything else stays quiet so the light can say where you are.

Surfaces are soft. Panels are cream paper lifted off the page by a low navy shadow, with no drawn outline; controls are pills; headings are set in a book serif at a calm medium weight over a highly legible sans for everything you read or press. Density is comfortable, not sparse: 14.5px body, 44px controls, panels padded 14 to 24px.

This record covers Porch Light as shipped on the setup step "Ask LinkedIn for your connections". The source in `ds/aik/` also carries four other themes (Night, Index, Switchboard, Classic) that swap colours, radii, faces and timing through the same tokens. They are not shipped here and are not recorded; their devices do not belong on a Porch Light screen.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper page, cream panels, navy ink; amber appears only as light.
Lamps carry state: unlit, breathing (current), lit (done), joined by a string that fills.
Panels have shadow and no stroke; controls and tags are full pills.
Newsreader for headings at weight 500, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for body and controls, Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono for numerals and file names.
One solid navy button per view; one dark dusk panel per screen.
Slow, settling motion (280 / 420 / 700ms on a long ease-out) that collapses under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Lamplight Rule
rules.body: Bright amber (`accent`, `lit-face`) is light, not ink. It fills lamps, strings, rings and icon strokes. Amber words on paper use `hold-ink` or `accent-ink`.

rules.name: The Tokens Only Rule
rules.body: Component rules read semantic tokens (`--bg`, `--ink`, `--accent`), never raw hex and never the primitive scale (`--paper-100`, `--amber-400`). That is what lets one stylesheet serve every theme.

rules.name: The Level Voice Rule
rules.body: Serif headings stay at weight 500 with -0.015em tracking, sentence case. No bold serif, no uppercase, no tracking-out.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Serif is for headings and the brand only. Anything pressed, scanned or measured (buttons, tags, labels, numbers) is the sans or the mono.

rules.name: The No Stroke Rule
rules.body: In Porch Light the border width token is 0 and the line colour is clear. A surface gets its edge from shadow and tone. Hairlines exist only as dividers between rows and as inset rings on tags and ghost buttons.

rules.name: The Lit Means Lit Rule
rules.body: Glow marks state (a lamp that is done or current). It is never a hover effect, a card decoration or a substitute for elevation.

dos: **Do** read semantic tokens from `ds/aik/tokens.css` for every colour, shadow and radius, and build on the classes in `ds/aik/components/bundle.css` before adding page rules.
**Do** show progress with lamps: unlit, breathing for current, lit for done, with a string that fills between them.

**Do** keep exactly one solid navy button in view, and move it when the next action changes (after the user returns from LinkedIn, the opened link becomes a ghost and "I've requested it" becomes solid).
**Do** give every control inside setup a 44px minimum height and the focus ring from the `--focus` token.
**Do** draw icons as inline SVG outlines in the current colour with round caps and joins.
**Do** hold line lengths: 21ch for the title, 64ch for the lede, 62ch for step copy.
**Do** replace a breathing lamp with a steady glow under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: **Don't** draw a stroke around a panel. Porch Light surfaces have shadow and tone, no border.
**Don't** set text in bright amber on paper. Use `hold-ink` or `accent-ink` for amber words.
**Don't** use glow for hover, emphasis or decoration. Glow means a lamp is lit.
**Don't** put a second dusk panel on a screen.
**Don't** bold, uppercase or letter-space the serif.
**Don't** make a drawing of another product's interface look operable: no hover states, no focus stops, no real form controls.
**Don't** bring the other themes' devices into Porch Light: hard offset shadows, drawn borders, uppercase mono tags and square corners belong to Index, Switchboard and Classic.
